map.根据钢种与热处理工艺估算回火后硬度（HRC）: Estimate the post-tempering hardness (HRC) from the steel grade and heat-treatment process
map.📖 查看「热处理硬度/温度曲线 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Heat-Treatment Hardness / Temperature Curve Guide"
map.💡 回火硬度 ≈ 淬火硬度 - k×(T回火-150)/100，再根据截面尺寸和: 💡 Tempered hardness ≈ quenched hardness − k×(T_temper−150)/100, then reduced according to the section size and hardenability. The data are empirical estimates.
map.常用钢种热处理参数: Heat-treatment parameters of common steel grades
map.📚 深度解析：淬透性与截面硬度: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Hardenability and Section Hardness
map.按截面尺寸与临界淬透直径判断心部是否淬透。: Judge whether the core is fully hardened from the section size and the critical hardening diameter.
map.比较不同钢种的淬硬层深度。: Compare the hardened-case depth of different steel grades.
map.大截面件改选高淬透性钢种。: Select a higher-hardenability steel grade for large sections.
map.某钢临界淬透直径 D0=30 mm（油淬）。截面 50 mm > 30 mm：心: For a steel with critical hardening diameter D0=30 mm (oil quench), a 50 mm section > 30 mm means the core cannot be fully hardened and its hardness is markedly lower than the surface (e.g. 55 HRC at the surface, 35 HRC at the core); switch to a steel with a larger D0 or use water quenching.
map.表硬随距表面增大而降，有效淬硬层深按 HRC 降 50% 处界定。: The surface hardness decreases with distance from the surface; the effective case depth is defined where the HRC drops by 50%.
map.淬透性=能淬透的截面大小（合金元素影响）；淬硬性=能达到的最高硬度（碳含量决定）: Hardenability = the section size that can be fully hardened (influenced by alloying elements); achievable hardness = the maximum hardness that can be reached (determined by carbon content). The two differ.
map.截面超限怎么办？: What if the section exceeds the limit?
map.选更高淬透性钢、提高冷却烈度（水淬/淬火液）或改表面淬火（感应/渗碳）只硬表层。: Choose a higher-hardenability steel, increase the cooling severity (water quench / quenchant) or switch to surface hardening (induction / carburising) to harden only the surface layer.
